def canonical_url(url):
    # Reject non-strings
    if not isinstance(url, str):
        raise ValueError("URL must be a string")
    
    # Reject missing host
    if '://' not in url:
        raise ValueError("URL must have a scheme")
    
    # Split scheme and rest
    scheme, rest = url.split('://', 1)
    
    # Accept only http or https
    if scheme.lower() not in ('http', 'https'):
        raise ValueError("Only http and https schemes are allowed")
    
    # Lowercase scheme
    scheme = scheme.lower()
    
    # Split host and path (fragment might be present)
    if '#' in rest:
        rest, fragment = rest.split('#', 1)
    
    # Split host and path
    if '?' in rest:
        host, path = rest.split('?', 1)
    else:
        host, path = rest, ''
    
    # Lowercase host
    host = host.lower()
    
    # Reject missing host
    if not host:
        raise ValueError("URL must have a host")
    
    # Remove fragment
    path = path.rstrip('/')
    
    # Remove trailing slash from non-root paths
    if path and not path.endswith('/'):
        pass  # Keep as is
    elif path == '':
        pass  # Root path, keep empty
    else:
        # Remove trailing slash from non-root paths
        path = path.rstrip('/')
    
    # Reconstruct URL with preserved query
    if '?' in path:
        path, query = path.split('?', 1)
        path = path.rstrip('/')
    
    return f"{scheme}://{host}{path}{query}"

from urls import canonical_url

# Test cases
def test_canonical_url():
    # Test basic normalization
    assert canonical_url("http://Example.COM/path/") == "http://example.com/path"
    assert canonical_url("https://example.com/path/") == "https://example.com/path"
    assert canonical_url("http://example.com/") == "http://example.com"
    assert canonical_url("http://example.com/path?query=1#fragment") == "http://example.com/path?query=1"
    assert canonical_url("http://example.com/path?query=1") == "http://example.com/path?query=1"
    
    # Test with trailing slash on root
    assert canonical_url("http://example.com/") == "http://example.com"
    
    # Test lowercase scheme and host
    assert canonical_url("HTTPS://EXAMPLE.COM/PATH/") == "https://example.com/path"
    
    # Test preserving query exactly
    assert canonical_url("http://example.com/path?query=1&foo=bar") == "http://example.com/path?query=1&foo=bar"
    
    # Test fragment removal
    assert canonical_url("http://example.com/path#section") == "http://example.com/path"
    
    # Test fragment with query
    assert canonical_url("http://example.com/path?query=1#section") == "http://example.com/path?query=1"
    
    # Test no trailing slash on non-root
    assert canonical_url("http://example.com/path") == "http://example.com/path"
    
    # Test empty path
    assert canonical_url("http://example.com") == "http://example.com"
    
    # Test with port
    assert canonical_url("http://example.com:8080/path/") == "http://example.com:8080/path"
    
    # Test https
    assert canonical_url("https://example.com:443/path/") == "https://example.com:443/path"
    
    # Test errors
    try:
        canonical_url(123)
        assert False, "Should raise ValueError for non-string"
    except ValueError:
        pass
    
    try:
        canonical_url("not a url")
        assert False, "Should raise ValueError for missing host"
    except ValueError:
        pass
    
    try:
        canonical_url("ftp://example.com/path")
        assert False, "Should raise ValueError for non-http/https scheme"
    except ValueError:
        pass
    
    try:
        canonical_url("http://example.com")
        assert False, "Should raise ValueError for missing host"
    except ValueError:
        pass
    
    print("All tests passed!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_canonical_url()
